thread:
mia_sales: Heads-up — HelioCore exec escalated: they want signed attestation + BYO-KMS flow signoff by EOD Friday to close the commit. Primary asks: SOC2 artifacts, egress pricing confirmation, and Dedicated cluster latency SLA. Can eng/legal confirm blockers?

jordan_se: I can validate Dedicated latency numbers. For BYO-KMS we need keywrap details and HSM attestation. @sam_eng can you confirm capacity/lead time for ~250 req/s baseline?

sam_eng: We can provision a dedicated pool but need committed qps and avg sequence length. For 250 req/s with occasional bursts I recommend 2x our baseline GPU config. Lead time ~4 business days for allocation and networking peering.

alina_legal: Quick legal note — we need a signed NDA before sharing SOC2 PDFs. We also require completion of their security questionnaire and a copy of their PIR (Product Information Request). Are they willing to sign our standard NDA?

mia_sales: They're okay with our standard NDA per the CISO, signing now. Also they asked about egress pricing: @nora_re can you confirm enterprise discount tiers and whether bandwidth is included in Dedicated pricing?

nora_re: For reserved Dedicated we can include 10TB/mo in the base price; overage at $0.08/GB. Annual commit gets ~20% discount on list. I'll prepare a short pricing note and T&Cs.

sam_eng: One more technical: HelioCore requires FIPS-validated crypto in the KMS path. Our BYO-KMS supports FIPS only if the customer provides a FIPS-validated HSM and we add the SOW language. Need confirmation from them.

alina_legal: That's doable. If they provide a FIPS HSM and we include SOW addendum covering key management responsibilities, legal is OK. Timeline: NDA (today), SOW addendum (2 business days), SOC2 under NDA (once NDA received).

mia_sales: Propose 1pm PT tomorrow sync with HelioCore CISO + our legal + eng to close checklist. @ops_oncall_bot schedule if available.

ops_oncall_bot: Meeting scheduled — HelioCore CISO sync on 2026-03-23 13:00 PST. Calendar invites sent to: mia_sales, jordan_se, sam_eng, alina_legal, nora_re, helio_ciso@heliocore.com.

jordan_se: I'll put together a 1-page tech brief (latency/throughput targets, GPU type, fallback variants, quantization options). Will upload to /drive/HelioCore/tech-brief.pdf by EOD.

sam_eng: Action items assigned: @jordan_se => tech one-pager; @nora_re => pricing spreadsheet and egress scenarios; @alina_legal => NDA + SOW addendum drafts. I'll open provisioning ticket in infra queue (#infra-requests/2871) and link it here.

mia_sales: Thanks all. I'll confirm with customer and share signed NDA once it's in. Ping me for any blocker — we'll aim to close this by Friday. :thumbsup:
